title: The Pinned Piece
subtitle: Absolute Pins, Half-Pins, and Piling Up on the Paralyzed Target
summary: Mastering the paralyzing power of the pin: the distinction between wholly pinned and half-pinned pieces, piling up attackers, and techniques for unpinning.
aphorism: A pinned piece is a paralyzed piece. The golden rule: pile on the pinned piece with your smallest units until it collapses.
attribution: 100th Anniversary Centenary Edition. Newly authored prose and interactive studies inspired by Aron Nimzowitsch (1925).

body.historicalContext: Nimzowitsch dissected the pin not merely as a one-move trick, but as a strategic condition that induces chronic paralysis across an entire sector of the board.

sections.title: Wholly Pinned vs. Half-Pinned Pieces
sections.markdown:
A **[[pin]]** occurs when a piece cannot move without exposing a more valuable piece behind it.

- **Wholly Pinned**: When pinned directly against the king, the piece cannot move at all under penalty of an illegal move.
- **Half-Pinned**: When pinned along a ray (such as a bishop on the diagonal or rook on a file), the pinned unit retains the ability to move *along the line of the pin*, but cannot leave it.

Black puts the question to the bishop.

sections.title: The Golden Rule: Piling Up on the Pinned Piece
sections.markdown:
When an enemy piece is pinned, do not rush to trade immediately!

Instead, **pile up additional attackers** on the pinned piece. Here White pins the f6 knight with **1.Bg5!**, and when Black plays **1...d6**, White leaps with **2.Nd5!**, overloading the pinned defender and shattering Black's kingside.

moves.comment: White pins the f6 knight against Black's queen.
Nimzo's golden rule: jumping another attacker onto the pinned unit!
White captures with check, inflicting ruined pawns on Black.

drills.title: Apply the Pin
drills.markdown: Pin Black's f6 knight against the queen with your dark-squared bishop.

feedback.correct: Excellent! The knight is pinned, restricting Black's kingside coordination.
feedback.wrong: Develop your bishop to g5 to pin the knight.
